museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research
title: 视觉艺术与研究中心：杰作
subtitle: 尼科西亚视觉艺术与研究中心收藏中的港口、植物、古迹与速写。
introduction:
港边仓库、一枝花茎、一座匆匆勾出的雕像，以很不相同的尺度记录塞浦路斯。这份来自尼科西亚视觉艺术与研究中心（CVAR）的选集，将它们放在一起，却不要求它们组成一幅完整统一的海岛图景。有些作品保存了明确命名的建筑，有些只给出大致地点，还有几件的作者尚无法可靠确认。

题注在这里尤其重要。写下的地点与日期，可以把一幅水彩放回某次旅行；旅行者给出的历史名称，却也可能需要纠正。这些画见证的是具体的人如何观看和记录，而不是通向一个永远不变的塞浦路斯的透明窗口。图像与 随附文字应被视作相互关联、却各有性质的记录。
visitNote: 这些是尼科西亚视觉艺术与研究中心（Centre of Visual Arts and Research）的馆藏记录。纸本作品会轮换展出，所选作品并不代表固定的展示路线。历史地名和说明文字源自原始藏品；它们既不反映当前的通行状况，也不界定现代地理格局。原始水印予以保留。

books.title: Our Home in Cyprus
books.author: Esmé Scott-Stevenson (1880)
books.access: 可通过 Google 图书获取免费的数字化英文版；具体可用情况及登录要求可能因情况而异。
books.note: 斯科特-史蒂文森（Scott-Stevenson）的作品中包含描绘塞浦路斯风景的画作，她也曾撰文记述自己在当地的生活与游历。她的著作是一份带有英国殖民视角色彩的历史文献。在阅读书中的文字描述时，不妨结合插图进行审视，并思考：在这些叙述中，哪些人的活动与视角被遗漏或排除在外了？

works.title: 法马古斯塔，圣乔治·克索里诺斯教堂
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 教堂立在树木与耕地后方，石墙并不孤立，而属于一个仍有植物生长、有人使用的环境。小径将前景与建筑相连。这幅景色记录的不只是古迹的轮廓，也保留了它当时周围的具体安排；不能假定这些安排至今未变。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 拉齐尼夫人肖像
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 画中人的姓名流传下来，画家的姓名却没有。深色裙装与浅色镶边，让她的姿势在淡色背景前清楚可辨，双手停在腰际附近。这些已足够作一次仔细的肖像描述，却不足以说明拉齐尼夫人的职业、家庭经历或性格。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 塞浦路斯盐湖
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 湖与天空铺展成淡淡的水平带状，细长的棕榈和植物茎干穿插其间。这些竖向形状帮助判断空间的开阔，却没有将它填满。这里尤其适合节制地描写；若每处都加上同样多的细节，反而难以感受水面的宽度与两端之间的距离。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 普拉特雷斯的树木
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 树木疏密的变化，让向下延伸的坡地清楚起来。较深的树干标明近处地面，山丘则将景色引向远方。没有署名的风景也能保存一种具体的空间关系。作者姓名缺失，是记录中的空白，不是让人虚构某位旅行者的理由。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 凯里尼亚港的角豆仓库
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 宽阔码头与岸边仓库，让港口显出工作场所的性质。沿着海岸弧线看去，便能理解建筑与其面向的水域之间的联系。标题点明角豆储存这一用途，将目光引向经济活动；而一幅漂亮的港景，很容易让人忽略这一层。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 来自佩杜拉斯
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 标题里的地方，没有通过广阔景色来呈现，而是由几枝开花植物代表。枝杈、叶片与花朵在空白纸面上各自分明。这是旅行记录的另一种尺度：一个地方也可以通过手边细察之物被记住，不必总被浓缩为全景或地标。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 望向阿吉亚伊里尼湾与莫尔富
works.catalogueTitle: From the top of a mountain (Agia Irini Bay, Morphou)
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 高处视点将土地排成层层远近：眼前粗粝地面，其外是山脊，再远是通向大海的海岸平原。前景让这些宽阔区域的大小有了参照。这是从特定位置选取的景色，并非一张中立地图，不能概括标题提到的全部地域。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 男性形象
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 一条弯曲手臂与几道衣褶，就组织起这个轻轻勾出的身体。未完成的头部和缺席的环境，让目光停留在姿势上。画中几乎没有依据来判定情绪或场合。它的价值恰恰在于有所选择：只需少量形体关系，就能让站立的人变得可辨。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 古代文物
works.license: The  Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 物件的侧面轮廓只占纸张一小部分。较深线条区分出一侧，但素描没有提供考古背景，无法由此确认原先用途。保留博物馆较宽泛的题名，正是尊重这一限度。描边很仔细，鉴定却不确定，这两点可以同时存在于一份记录中。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 古代女性雕像
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 弯曲手臂与靠近胸部的双手，在正面躯干两侧形成呼应，头部则画得较少。巴克斯特从雕塑中选择了一种身体安排，并未试图完整临摹。这样的节省使素描便于比较形态，却不能代替雕像本身所包含的更全面信息。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 塞浦路斯：为神父剃须
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 坐着的男人被其他人物围住，并未像肖像主体那样被单独突出。题注说明正在进行的服务，松散的室内描绘与近旁物件，却让环境的许多细节仍不清楚。纸面记录了一种社交情境，无法确定每位参与者是谁，也不能交代相聚的确切缘由。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 拉纳卡盐湖与斯塔夫罗沃尼山
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 水面与远山构成景色，题字则固定了地点与某一天：1938年3月9日。图像和题注各有工作，一个安排可见的远近，一个把这一站放回旅途的次序。两者合在一起，让水彩比笼统的“塞浦路斯印象”更具体。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 凯里尼亚灯塔
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 灯塔被拉得足够近，砌石在水面前清楚可见；一艘帆船又把港口空间向后延伸。巴尔福的历史题注属于记录的一部分，但其中“古罗马灯塔”的说法不应被当成考古断代。旅行者的标注保存的是当时的认识，未必是经过核实的事实。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 贝拉佩斯修道院
works.catalogueTitle: Abbey of Bella Paise - Kyrenia Built by Hugh IV, King of Cyprus 1324 March 1
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 树木与绿色山坡围住残存拱廊，把修道院放进更广的地貌。装裱上的题注记录了巴尔福的到访，以及他对遗址历史的理解。两者应当分开：画面可以说明他如何描绘建筑，却不能因此证实下方写出的每一句话。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 花朵
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 盛开的花、花苞与叶子，让不同生长阶段同时出现在一条分枝茎干上。浅色背景使每个连接点都便于细察。它不像扎成紧密团块的花束，而是依靠各部分之间的空隙来成立。小植物因此可以占据纸面，又不失去自身细部结构。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 凯里尼亚
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 细线勾出建筑与船桅，倒影又把其中一些竖线延伸到水里。暖色纸张仍露在笔痕之间，不必每处另铺水彩，也能贡献颜色。港口因此部分依靠未被画过的地方形成，而不是来自一张均匀填满的画面。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 阿马图斯遗址
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 不规则边框圈住废墟、树木和小人物，山峦在后方展开。博物馆只是试探性地把作品与帕尔斯联系起来，这一归属仍不确定，转述时不应变成肯定的署名。保留疑问不妨碍讨论构图：人物的大小在这里被纳入了远为广阔的风景。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 法马古斯塔清真寺
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 哥特式建筑与宣礼塔同处一条天际线。两者并置，让建筑的变迁可见，而不要求先前形态已经消失。小人物与较低房屋使此地仍显得有人居住，不像孤立的建筑标本。水彩保存的是一个特定历史时刻的景象，而非遗址今日的面貌。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 塞浦路斯：从林木覆盖的山顶远望
works.catalogueTitle: View from a wooded hilltop, Cyprus
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 宽大的树冠构成纸上最强烈的形状，较细树干将它们托在低矮地面上方。彼此的间隔，让山顶成为有缝隙、有开口的地方，而不是连成一片的绿色。无名作者究竟是谁，与这种安排让画面能够显示什么，是两件应当区分的事。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

works.title: 古代雕像
works.license: The Costas and Rita Severis Foundation holds or manages the copyright(s) of this item and its digital reproduction. If you need information about using this item, please send an email to [email protected]
works.description: 这张来自巴克斯特1921年旅途的小纸页，同时容纳素描与文字。正面雕像的姿势被简化为几道轮廓，其中一只手靠向胸前。CVAR 将他的塞浦路斯习作与服装设计联系起来：旅行速写既可记录亲见之物，也可能成为日后创作的材料。
works.museum: Centre of Visual Arts and Research

closingSections.title: 图像只是记录的一种
paragraphs: 请沿作品链接查看题字与目录信息，尤其是在建筑名称或作者归属不确定时。今天的地名、开放情况与保存状态，需要另外核实。选集介绍的是收藏记录，不是当前展厅陈列；图像复制许可，也须与参观博物馆的许可分开确认。
